summary: Validated UI changes for TAM Score in Thesis Engine (Spanish app). All 4 frontend tests passed: trend thesis CompanyCard now shows 'Score global tendencia' label with TAM Score boxed below the overall score; CompanyQualCard on /company/{ticker} renders a table with one row per saved trend thesis, column headers 'Score global tendencia' and 'TAM Score', and an aggregates row with mean overall and sum of TAM scores. Navigation from qual-row-link works. Anonymous users see the login prompt instead of the table.

critical_code_review_comments: CompanyQualCard.jsx (line 33): returns null while loading, which can cause layout shift; consider a skeleton or stable placeholder.
ThesisResult.jsx TamScoreBadge uses fixed-width 11x10 box for loading state — fine, but spinner color #9CA3AF can be hard to see on light cream background; consider darker spinner.
ThesisResult.jsx line 319 useEffect depends on entire `thesis` object — if parent re-renders thesis identity (even unchanged), it will re-fetch TAM scores. Consider depending on thesis.id.
